description: This file defines the 'Video' class, which represents a video resource related to a web page, providing methods to retrieve its path, save it to disk, or delete it. It interacts with external artifacts and manages asynchronous operations related to video artifacts.

classes.name: Video
classes.description: Represents a video recording of a web page session, providing methods to access its path, save, and delete the video.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a new Video instance, determining if it's remote and setting up artifact promises.

methods.name: _artifactReady
methods.description: Resolves the internal promise when the artifact is ready.

methods.name: path
methods.description: Returns the absolute path of the video artifact, throws if remote or artifact not available.

methods.name: saveAs
methods.description: Saves the video artifact to the specified path.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the video artifact if it exists.
